evidence.quote: Try AWS Security Hub at no cost with a 30-day free trial that includes Essentials plan capabilities. Every AWS account in each Region enabled with Security Hub receives a free trial, even if you previously used AWS Security Hub CSPM or Amazon Inspector free trials.

Add-on capabilities (threat analytics powered by Amazon GuardDuty and AWS Lambda code scanning powered by Amazon Inspector) and the Extended plan are not included in the Security Hub free trial, though individual service free trials still apply if you have not used them previously.
